author: Eternalll
name: Brutus
short: Warn, mute, kick, ban and view users from the Apps menu of messages and users.
description: Warn, mute, kick or ban users from the Apps menu of messages and users, with preset reasons and the same results as Red's own commands. Also privately view a user's modlog cases, recent messages and user info.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users. Warnings, mutes and modlog cases it creates are stored by Red's Warnings and Mutes cogs and Red's modlog. When ban message export is turned on, a banned user's messages cached by Defender are posted as a file to a channel chosen by the server's admins.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Brutus. Load it, then run `[p]slash enablecog brutus` and `[p]slash sync` to add Warn, Mute, Kick, Ban and View User to the Apps menu of messages and users. These use all 5 message and 5 user entries Discord allows per bot. Set preset reasons with `[p]brutusset reasons`, and see everything with `[p]brutusset show`.
